description: A soldier's kit laid out on his cot — an intimate still-life almost certainly of LARRY'S OWN corner of the hooch. On the neat cot (white pillow and sheet, OD blanket): an M1 HELMET at the pillow, a THOMPSON SMG laid across the bed with magazine in, a PISTOL BELT with holster and what appears to be a looped AMMUNITION BELT coiled beside it, a sheathed KNIFE with stacked-leather handle, and a single loose cartridge near the Thompson. Above, a rolled MOSQUITO NET slung under the upper bunk's frame; behind, a wooden wardrobe and an open shelf unit holding magazines (colorful covers), sandals/shower shoes, and folded linens; reed-matting wall with rolled blind at right; red patterned matting on the floor edge.
